title: 2. Conditional open-loop contact-dwell calibration
hypothesis: After warp qualification, an interior contact-dwell optimum permits a different warp magnitude to improve sustained success while preserving cycle mean and RMS.

prediction.against: the frozen D-062 epsilon=-0.35 warp, only if qualified by idea 1
prediction.rationale: Independent confirmation must demonstrate additional success beyond the qualified warp; screen gains alone cannot establish a useful dwell optimum.

protocol.command: gpu run 'source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study warp_magnitude_followup --require-qualified-result logs/pen_spin/warp_qualification_90_s4700 --frozen-candidate-decision D-062 --epsilon-grid=-0.15,-0.25,-0.45,-0.55 --screen-seed 4703 --confirmation-seed 4704 --output-dir logs/pen_spin/warp_magnitude_followup_s4703'
code_changes: scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py: reuse D-062's open-loop warp screening and confirmation machinery; expose the command's conditional-study arguments.
Check idea 1's qualification and no-more-drops gate before creating manifests or consuming seeds; run only after that protocol finishes.
This is the explicitly permitted magnitude follow-up, not a claim of a new controller mechanism: screen four magnitudes and the qualified -0.35 control on 40 cases each.
For each magnitude, freeze per-channel mean/RMS normalization on the same 3600-point grid; retain all other controller constants and prohibit feedback.
Freeze one screen winner using success, then fewer drops, then proximity to -0.35 as deterministic tie-breaks; compare it with the qualified control on independent cases 10-39 and 40-119.

Require strict promotion and a fresh paired interval above zero, with no more observed drops on either panel, before replacement; report sustained success, drops, and per-axis saturation. No second screen.

falsified_by: A fresh-confirmation paired interval upper bound below +0.05 refutes the predicted gain. An interval including zero is inconclusive. If idea 1 does not qualify, cancel this protocol without consuming its seeds.
